items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Lil Unintelligible could have been saying that from a word, when you come into a place.

ctx.x: Like Louis Armstrong told me, the first blues he had ever heard was called, "Funky Butt", which later became, "Stinky Butt", and different names.

Yeah, well you know where that come from, Lil Unintelligible could have been saying that from a word, when you come into a place. There's a little song that's called, I thought I heard somebody say, 9 Funky Butt, Funky Butt, take it away.", you know what I mean? Well, it meant that you didn't smell good.

items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Clarence Williams was there with Eva Taylor... they had an act, and they was on the same bill, and we played for CHAPPELLE and Stinnette

ctx.x: Yeah. And Ethel Waters -- er, Williams was the dancer and Ethel Williams, I mean Ethel Waters, was the singer.
